prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo-only source tile for a low-poly fantasy alpine snow terrain material
Primary request: Create a soft bluish off-white alpine snow crust albedo for high Whitehorn and Mirrorhold ground, with low-contrast irregular granules and a little embedded rock dust.
Style/medium: restrained painterly low-poly fantasy ground like Eloria's approved grass/desert surfaces; calm medium-scale mottling, never photorealistic.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic square ground material, even natural distribution; opposite left-right edges and opposite top-bottom edges wrap seamlessly; no frame or focal formation.
Color palette: cool off-white, very pale blue-grey and subtle neutral shadowless grey variation; avoid saturated blue.
Materials/textures: settled wind-packed crust with fine irregular granules, diffuse powdery surface and occasional tiny muted grey mineral dust flecks; gentle low-contrast variation; intended world repeat 4 metres and gameplay-camera legibility.
Lighting/mood: completely uniform neutral diffuse albedo, no light direction or baked shadow.
Constraints: both-axis seamless repetition; flat base-color texture only; snow surface, not a glacier or ice sheet.
Avoid: dense cracked ice, deep fissures, sharp fracture lines, glossy ice, blue bands, large rocks, dramatic wind ridges, sparkle/highlights, high-frequency speckle, footprints, plants, scene/perspective, directional shading, gradients, borders, frame, text, logo, watermark.
